content.body: The French Rifle Grenadier employed a regular infantry rifle and a cup-launched fragmentation grenade. Unlike the British HEAT grenade, it was an anti-personnel weapon.
content.brief: WEAPON: Fusil mle 1886 m 1893 "Lebel" AMMO: Cartouche de 8 mm mle 1886 D (am) MAGAZINE: 8 round tube magazine MUZZLE VELOCITY: 716 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Grenade Firing Cup Vivien-Bessière HE Grenades (10) Combat Knife
content.title: Grenadier
